title: A continuous determinant n-covector on ℝⁿ normalized on the standard basis
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ there is an n-covector δ of ℝⁿ (δ ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form on ℝⁿ) with δ(e₁, …, eₙ) = 1, where eᵢ = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the standard basis of ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ δ : Covector (Euclid n) n, δ (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = 1
